preferences.enableContent: Choose a poetic form to start creating.
preferences.title: Creation preferences
preferences.scope: Preferences sync automatically to your account across browsers and devices. They are separate from the app and do not affect submitted tasks.
preferences.languageHelp: Poetry supports simplified and traditional Chinese only, with traditional as the default. Tags and photo descriptions use the tag language.
preferences.lineHelp: A couplet has two lines; each independently uses five or seven characters.
preferences.noCi: No matching pattern. Clear the search or choose automatically.
preferences.rhymeHelp: For Cantonese reading, Pingshui or Cilin is recommended; for Mandarin, Zhonghua or Zhongyuan is recommended.
preferences.suggestHelp: Show composition suggestions with the photo information. Generating poetry and suggestions together uses one creation credit.
preferences.saved: Synced to your account. Applies to your next creation.
preferences.saveFailed: Sync failed. Changes have not been saved to your account. Retry before leaving this page or unsaved changes will be lost.
preferences.loadFailed: Unable to load account preferences. Retry before editing preferences or starting a new creation.
preferences.nextTask: New tasks use your account preferences
